bridge.where: The land of Israel; Jerusalem; and Saba, in Yemen
text: After Musa, the Children of Israel lived under judges and prophets. The Quran also names Dhul-Kifl, whose identity is uncertain.

When enemies threatened them, they asked God for a king. This chapter follows that king's army, the young Dawud, known as David, who becomes king and prophet, and his son Sulayman, known as Solomon, whose kingdom has no equal.
